import re

# Simple, explicit mapping for bracketed words/phrases -> synonyms
synonyms = {
    "construct": "devise",
    "improve": "enhance",
}

text = "How to [construct] a study plan to [improve] my grades?"

def replace_bracketed(text, mapping):
    def repl(match):
        key = match.group(1)
        return mapping.get(key, key)  # if missing, leave unchanged
    return re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]", repl, text)
